## Purpose
Marks `backend/app` as the `app` package; every backend import is `from app.… import …`.

## Responsibilities
- Makes `app` importable when the process runs with `backend/` as its working directory (uvicorn `app.main:app`, the worker, pytest).

## Key elements
None. The file holds a single comment line, `# Backend App Package`.

## Control flow
None.

## Data, state and side effects
None.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
Every module under `backend/app` relies on the package name `app`. `backend/` must be the current directory or on `sys.path`.

## Error handling and edge cases
None.

## Nuances and gotchas
- The package is called `app`, not `backend`. Imports such as `from backend.app…` do not work anywhere in the code.
- `tool-service/app` is a different package with the same name and runs in its own process. Never put both on one `sys.path`.

## How to rebuild this file
Create `backend/app/__init__.py` containing exactly `# Backend App Package` followed by a newline.

None.
